name: Granshine
desc: A large sword wrapped in rainbow light. Imbued with every sort of power imaginable, there isn't a soul who could hope to survive a strike from this blade.

eff.name: Blessing of the Four Spirits
eff.desc1: Deals [20 + (Lv. x 5)] power fire, ice, bolt, and air damage. Puts other items on cooldown and increases damage by [the number of items on cooldown x 20]%.
eff.desc2: Deals [20 + (Lv. x 5)] power fire, ice, bolt, and air damage. Reduces cooldowns for other items by [Lv. x 5]%.

eff.name: Glimmering Swordplay
eff.desc2: Increases environmental mana acquired by [Lv. x 1]% on a critical hit.

eff.name: Polar Star's Radiance
eff.desc1: Restores HP by [Lv. x 3]% of the damage dealt to the target.
eff.desc2: Reduces target's maximum HP by [Lv. x 5]%.
